title: Minaret of Jam, Ghor

terrainReference.basis: Original source terrain sampled at the mapped tower center. Coarse field includes the adjacent river bend. Local foundation and retaining edges are approximate.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap way 533125855 supplies the approximate mapped tower outline and center. The UNESCO World Heritage record establishes the 65 m height and the 9 m diameter octagonal base, which refine the broader mapped outline.
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap way 533125855 fixes the approximate center and plan. UNESCO’s 9 m octagonal base replaces the generalized sixteen-sided map outline. Its 65 m height and the survey-based reported lean bound the shaft profile.

note: The three exact 2006 Qualla photographs establish the taper, alternating relief bands, turquoise register, broken balcony supports and crown. The exact positions and individual motifs are interpreted from those views. UNESCO supplies the 9 m base diameter and 65 m height. The survey reports a north-northeast inclination. Tier positions, azimuth of the octagon and individual faces are approximate. Ornament uses original geometric patterns without transcribing the inscription. The original 128 m elevation field is preserved. The unmasked field includes the river bend and valley slope. Local footing depth and water or retaining edges are not surveyed. The exterior represents the photographed tower only. Nearby archaeological remains, footbridges, protective walls and the river surface are outside the asset.
